paragraphs: Municibid runs an online auction service that government agencies, schools, authorities and utilities use to sell surplus and forfeitures directly to the public. All auctions run online and are open for bidding 24 hours a day. Homepage categories include Farm Equipment & Supplies, Police & Fire, Snow Removal and Water & Sewer.

Sellers named on the homepage include school districts, townships, boroughs, police departments and water authorities. The origin story on the about page places the start in early 2006 with Pottstown, PA councilman Greg Berry. The about page states that over 500 new government partners arrive each year.

Both pages state a figure of over 7,500 governments and schools. Bidding is open to the public, and a question on the about page says anyone can bid on a seller's auctions. The homepage also states that auction proceeds go back to the communities served.

quote.text: Municibid exists to turn government surplus into community value.
